page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3c.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 54,975 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps. The absence of local SSDs represents a trade-off, prioritizing high-capacity sequential storage over low-latency random I/O.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the utilization of HDD storage instead of SSDs lowers the cost per gigabyte of storage, making it suitable for large-scale data archiving, distributed file systems, and big data processing. The combination of 56 dedicated vCPUs, 40 Gbps network throughput, and massive local storage capacity aligns with workloads such as Hadoop MapReduce clusters, large-scale data warehousing, and cold storage databases.
